byte_divergent.name: Byte Divergent
byte_divergent.summary: Whether this choice may change emitted IL bytes.

oracle_endorsed.name: Oracle Endorsed
oracle_endorsed.summary: Whether the declared runtime style oracle endorses this choice.

corpus_endorsed.name: Corpus Endorsed
corpus_endorsed.summary: Whether the runtime source corpus endorses this choice.

guarded-boolean-return-style:conditional.name: Guarded boolean return style · Conditional expression (ternary)
guarded-boolean-return-style:conditional.summary: How to render a declined guarded boolean return: the byte-faithful flat if/return (default), the oracle-preferred ternary return c ? A : B; (byte-divergent), or the compact short-circuit "bool hack" (byte-divergent, not oracle-endorsed).

guarded-boolean-return-style:branchless.name: Guarded boolean return style · Branchless "bool hack"
guarded-boolean-return-style:branchless.summary: How to render a declined guarded boolean return: the byte-faithful flat if/return (default), the oracle-preferred ternary return c ? A : B; (byte-divergent), or the compact short-circuit "bool hack" (byte-divergent, not oracle-endorsed).

csharp.style-tiers.name: C# Style Tiers
csharp.style-tiers.summary: Fidelity and presentation tiers used to group C# style choices.

byte_divergent.name: Byte Divergent
byte_divergent.summary: Whether every choice in the tier may change emitted IL bytes.

Lens.name: Style lenses
Lens.summary: Keeps what the code does, but not the exact bytes: this rendering recompiles to different IL than the shipped output, so it is excluded from byte-level fidelity checking.
